request.source_text: The council approved a new library on Monday. Construction will start in June. The site has room for a reading garden and a classroom. Funding for the building comes from the town budget. The project team will publish a construction schedule. At the end of the meeting, the council confirmed that the library will open next March.
request.summary_text: Construction of the new library will start in June. It will open next March.
request.reference_summary_text: The council approved a library whose construction starts in June and whose opening is planned for next March.

request.source_text: The museum closes on Tuesday. Admission is free on Friday.
request.reference_summary_text: Tuesday is the museum's closing day; Friday admission is free.
